title: GSM1587300
extract_protocol_ch1.1: Whole endometrial tissue pipelle biopsies were placed in RNA later immediately following biopsy (<1 min).  Following overnight incubation at 4 degrees C, samples were removed from RNA later and stored at -80 degrees C.  Total RNA was extracted using RNA STAT-60 reagent according to the manufacturer's protocol.  Purified RNA was treated using Invitrogen Amplification Grade DNase I, followed by ethanol precipitation and clean-up.  DNA-free RNA was submitted to Source Bioscience (Nottingham, UK) for library preparation and sequencing.
taxid_ch1: Library preparation was performed using Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA sample prep kit according to manufacturer's instructions.  The libraries were validated on the Agilent BioAnalyser 2100 to check the size distribution of the libraries and on the Qubit High Sensitivity to check the concentration of the samples.  Samples were pooled and pools were loaded at a concentration of 8pM onto 2 lanes of an Illumina HiSeq2000 flow cell v3.
data_processing.1: Transcriptomic maps of single-end reads were generated using bowtie-2.2.3, samtools-0.1.19, and tophat-2.0.12 against the University of California Santa Cruz (UCSC) hg19 reference transcriptome (2014) from the Illumina iGenomes resource using the fr-firststrand setting.
data_processing.2: Transcript counts were assessed by HTSeq-0.6.1 using the reverse strand setting and intersection-non-empty mode and counts were assigned to gene ids.
platform_id: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Lucas-Brosens_Processed Data_TPMs.txt contains TPM values
